rows.en: ＊Sarai＊＠１６６＿００７Oh... Um, sorry to bother you￥out of nowhere, but could you￥take a look at this?
＊Sarai＊＠１６６＿００８I think I cut my hand somewhere￥just now...
＊Sarai＊＠１６６＿０１０But never mind that. What I want￥you to look at is my... blood.
＊Sarai＊＠１６６＿０１１I tripped over there...｝￥＠１６６＿０１２But never mind that. I want you￥to look at this blood.
＊Sarai＊＠１６６＿０１３My blood is... white.｝￥＠１６６＿０１４That's strange, isn't it?￥Blood is... supposed to be red.
＊Sarai＊＠１６６＿０１７I don't know.￥What am I... What am I...
＊Sarai＊＠１６６＿０２０If I'm going to cause you any￥more trouble, I'll stay away￥from you.
＊Sarai＊＠１６６＿０２１Thank you for being so kind to￥someone like me, who doesn't￥even know where he came from...
＊????＊＠２１１＿０１３"Project Elan serial no."￥..."SPN19"￥"Android unit name: SARAI"＝...
＊Lab A＊＠２１１＿０１４I really thought this one would￥work... If we only had more￥time...
＊Lab B＊＠２１１＿０１５The project has given up on us.￥There's nothing we can do.＝＠２１１＿０１６Not one unit has worked with the￥advanced programming. We're in￥no position to complain.
＊Lab A＊＠２１１＿０１７We were finally starting to see￥why they go haywire once the￥emotion pulse passes a limit...
＊Lab B＊＠２１１＿０１８His memory is still locked.＝＠２１１＿０１９He shouldn't even be able to￥tell he's an android. Let's￥dispose of him as is.
＊Sarai＊＠１６７＿００８Now I remember a little￥about myself...＝＠１６７＿００９That replay was what the￥researchers said just as I was￥put to sleep.
＊Sarai＊＠１６７＿０１０I'm an android, built to explore￥Elan...＝＠１６７＿０１１and to simulate how humans would￥live there...＝＠１６７＿０１２SPN19, "SARAI."
＊Sarai＊＠１６７＿０１３SPN types like me were given an￥emotion program.＝＠１６７＿０１４We had to be more human-like to￥simulate all sorts of things.
＊Sarai＊＠１６７＿０１５But even with complex emotions,￥not a single android ever￥functioned properly.
＊Sarai＊＠１６７＿０１６If this goes on...￥I might hurt you!
＊Sarai＊＠１６７＿０１７What?!￥You trust me?＝＠１６７＿０１８Even though I'm an android, and￥maybe a defective one too?￥You still trust me?
＊Sarai＊＠１６７＿０２０Ah! The lock is coming off!!￥It's... too dangerous!＝＠１６７＿０２１Hur...ry... and... run...
＊Sarai＊＠１６７＿０２２Yes, you're right...＝＠１６７＿０２３I don't want to hurt you... so￥I'll never come near you again.
＊Sarai＊＠１６７＿０２４I don't think we'll ever meet￥again. Thank you for everything.＝＠１６７＿０２５Goodbye...
＊????＊＠２１１＿０２０Emotion pulse has passed￥threshold. ... All green. Normal￥operation confirmed.＝＠１６８＿００２Now releasing unit￥identity lock.
＊Sarai＊＠１６８＿００５I remember everything up to now,￥down to the smallest detail...＝＠１６８＿００６But other than that, I don't￥feel like anything's wrong...＝＠１６８＿００４I... haven't gone haywire,￥have I...?
＊Sarai＊＠１６８＿０１０If the lock was released, that￥means my emotion functions are￥working normally, right?＝＠１６８＿０１１And I haven't gone haywire!
＊Sarai＊＠１６８＿０１５It worked, didn't it?￥I'm the first...￥finished android...!
＊Sarai＊＠１６８＿０１７All that research, and they￥never managed a finished one!
＊Sarai＊＠１６８＿０１９I don't think the others before￥me ever met someone like you.＝＠１６８＿０２０I'm so lucky!
＊Sarai＊＠１６８＿０２１Oh... So this is what it feels￥like to be "happy"...
＊Sarai＊＠１６８＿０２２I'm so, so "happy"￥that I met you!＝＠１６８＿０２３I want to be useful to you, so￥I'll do my best!
